summary: Levy Professionals. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: Tech recruitment and consulting firm (Levy Global) placing IT professionals across the UK, Europe and North America since 2000; not a recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: Recruits and consults in data and AI, cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, software development and business change.
Works with scale-ups and global organisations, and says it supports people from first conversation through onboarding.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.
Its one open job here, a mid-level project role in the Amsterdam area, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Has been placing tech professionals since 2000.

worth_knowing.text: Works as a consulting and recruitment partner, so roles it posts can be placements with scale-ups and global organisations.
